claims.head: The Avalanche are going to test the Jets’ goalie early and often
claims.call: The Avalanche take at least their usual 69.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
claims.body: Winnipeg has been giving up shots all season, and the Avalanche rarely pass one up.
claims.nums: Colorado 1st for shot volume (69.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5) · Winnipeg 22nd for shot suppression
claims.gist: The Avalanche shoot a lot, and the Jets give up plenty.

claims.head: Nobody’s sitting back in this one
claims.call: The game runs at more than 88.2 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, faster than either team’s usual.
claims.body: Colorado plays some of the league’s fastest games, and so does Winnipeg. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.
claims.nums: Pace (shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams): Colorado 1st (88.2), Winnipeg 10th (83.2)
claims.gist: Both teams like a fast game.

WPG.head: Winnipeg faces a real test
WPG.body: Colorado has controlled the play far better over recent games and Winnipeg has home ice. Winnipeg’s best way through is a penalty kill that holds up.

COL.head: Colorado should have the upper hand
COL.body: Colorado has controlled the play far better over recent games and Winnipeg has home ice. Winnipeg’s way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.

story.head: The Avalanche are going to test the Jets’ goalie early and often
paras: The Jets have won two in a row. The Avalanche have won two in a row, the last a 6-1 rout of St. Louis.
The Avalanche shoot a lot, and the Jets give up plenty. Both teams like a fast game.
